about: Thermal Energy International Inc. engages in the development, engineering, and supply of pollution control, heat recovery systems, and condensate return solutions in North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers GEM steam traps, a permanent solution to steam trap failures and energy losses; FLUACE-ACE heat recovery, a direct contact condensing heat recovery system for industrial flue gas applications; Hybrid FLU-ACE, a direct fired water heater and contact economizer; and HeatSponge, an indirect contact boiler economizer. It also provides hot water and de-steaming solutions, which includes PERCO-ACE, a direct contact water heating and Rainmaker, boiler efficiency with waste heat recovery. The company serves its products to food and beverage, pulp and paper, hospital, pharmaceutical, chemicals and petrochemicals, meat processing, tire and rubber, tissue, dairy manufacturing, animal nutrition, and other industry sectors. Thermal Energy International Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada.
